title: Materials
description: Fibre composition per part (textile labelling regulation / DPP ready). Parts, materials and qualifiers are terms: a stable `code` and its `name` per language. For a code in the vocabulary of the specification (vocabularies/*.json) a node returns the vocabulary's name; for another code the name it was given, or null. A language without a name is omitted, never an empty string.

term.description: A stable code with its name per language. On write paths `name` may be omitted; responses always include it (null when unknown).

part.description: Part of the article. Codes in vocabularies/parts.json: main, outer, lining, filling, padding, trim, pocket_lining, shell (luggage), handle, strap, and for footwear upper, sole, insole. 'main' when the product has one composition; its name is null. Unknown codes are allowed.

fibers.description: Percentages of one part SHOULD sum to 100.

material.description: Material code: the English textile fibre name of Annex I of Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 in lowercase with _ (linen for flax), e.g. cotton, wool, polyester, polyamide, elastane, viscose, lyocell; the list with names is vocabularies/materials.json. Recycled or organic content is a qualifier, not a material.

qualifier.description: What the fibre is, apart from which fibre: organic, recycled, regenerative (vocabularies/qualifiers.json; unknown codes are allowed). null = none.
